records.title: Roadmap for Textile Sector till 2030
details: PM MITRA Parks Scheme: Under the scheme, 7 Mega Textile Parks with modern, integrated, large-scale, world-class infrastructure, and plug and play facility are being set up to attract investments in the textile sector and boost employment.

records.title: DEVELOPEMENT OF AMRAVATI AIRPORT UNDER THE UDAN SCHEME
details: (a) to (d) It was inter-alia stated that: The development of Amravati Airport is likely to be completed in 2024. On readiness of the Airport, Selected Airline Operator (SAO) may commence the flight operations under RCS UDAN.
